sentences.en: Zolan Kano-Youngs, White House correspondent and, we should note, CNN contributor.
sentences.zh: 佐兰·卡诺-扬斯，白宫记者，我们应该说明一下，他也是CNN的撰稿人。

sentences.en: Welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Thank you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，蕾切尔。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔·格林鲍姆。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So happy to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: You are a media reporter.
sentences.zh: 你是一位媒体记者。

sentences.en: You are also very invested in this story.
sentences.zh: 你对这个故事也投入了极大的关注。

sentences.en: So, Michael, let's start with you.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，我们先从你开始。

sentences.en: Tell us what has been happening between the press and the White House.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲媒体和白宫之间一直在发生什么。

sentences.en: So, seemingly out of the blue on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 所以在周五下午，这似乎来得十分突然。

sentences.en: Another shakeup in the White House press corps today.
sentences.zh: 今天白宫记者团又迎来了一场人事动荡。

sentences.en: President Trump decrees that three news outlets, CNN, Politico and MSNOW, are barred, effective immediately in his words, from entering the White House grounds.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统下令，禁止三家新闻机构——CNN、Politico和MSNOW——按照他的说法，即刻起不得进入白宫场地。

sentences.en: Putting out a post on Truth Social about this, saying other news media outlets to follow was...
sentences.zh: 他在“真实社交”上发帖称，其他新闻媒体也将步其后尘……

sentences.en: We had no heads up about this.
sentences.zh: 我们事先对此毫无风声。

sentences.en: Our reporting shows that White House aides were caught completely flat-footed.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道显示，白宫助手们完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: And by Saturday morning, the journalists from those outlets attempted to walk through the security gates like they usually do.
sentences.zh: 到了周六早晨，这些机构的记者试图像往常一样穿过安全大门。

sentences.en: She went through multiple checkpoints, as we always do.
sentences.zh: 她通过了多个安检点，就像我们平时做的那样。

sentences.en: Not only were they told they couldn't come in, their badges were confiscated by security officers.
sentences.zh: 不仅被拒之门外，他们的记者证还被安保人员没收了。

sentences.en: When teams were denied access from the executive branch grounds.
sentences.zh: 当时各团队被拒绝进入行政部门的场地。

sentences.en: This is an extraordinary escalation, even by the standards of a president who has threatened, who has sued, who has subpoenaed news outlets over the course of his two terMs.
sentences.zh: 这是一次非同寻常的升级，哪怕以这位总统的标准来看也是如此——他在两个任期内曾对新闻机构发出过威胁、起诉和传唤。

sentences.en: To expressly say these news organizations are banned from the grounds of the White House is something we simply have not seen from him.
sentences.zh: 明确表示禁止这些新闻机构进入白宫场地，这是我们以前从未从他身上见过的。

sentences.en: And so on Monday, we've seen something nearly unprecedented,
sentences.zh: 所以在周一，我们看到了几乎史无前例的一幕，

sentences.en: which is five major television networks banding together and agreeing that they would not cover presidential pool events out of solidarity with CNN.
sentences.zh: 那就是五大电视网联合起来，一致同意为了声援CNN而不再报道总统的随行采访活动。

sentences.en: Basically, anytime you turn on CNN or Fox News and you see the president talking live, you are watching the TV pool footage of that event.
sentences.zh: 基本上，每当你打开CNN或福克斯新闻看到总统在进行现场讲话时，你看到的都是该活动的电视池镜头。

sentences.en: And so that's a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一件大事。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: TV networks have been covering presidents back to the Eisenhower administration.
sentences.zh: 电视网从艾森豪威尔政府时期就开始报道总统了。

sentences.en: And we've almost never seen this type of collective action where they voluntarily lay down their cameras and do not cover the events for the historic record.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎从未见过这种集体行动：他们自愿放下摄像机，不再为历史档案记录这些活动。

sentences.en: What also makes this so intriguing is this is a president addicted to his TV coverage.
sentences.zh: 这也让人觉得如此引人入胜的原因在于，这是一位对电视报道有着瘾头般的总统。

sentences.en: He's obsessed with how he's portrayed on television and the idea of Donald Trump not having TV cameras recording his every move in utterance.
sentences.zh: 他痴迷于自己如何在电视上被塑造，而唐纳德·特朗普无法让电视摄像机记录他的一举一动和每一句话，这种想法……

sentences.en: I have no idea how he's going to react to that.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道他会对此作何反应。

sentences.en: So, as Michael mentioned, the president has basically been calling the press the enemy of the people for years now.
sentences.zh: 正如迈克尔所提到的，这位总统多年来基本上一直把媒体称为人民的敌人。

sentences.en: So why is this happening now?
sentences.zh: 那为什么现在会发生这种事呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's important to say that in the lead up to this, the president had faced some significant losses.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有必要指出，在此之前，总统已经遭受了一些重大的挫折。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We talk about how his first year in office was dominated basically by him expanding executive power and bending institutions to his will.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过他执政的第一年是如何被他扩大行政权力和迫使体制屈服于他的意志所主导的。

sentences.en: Well, in the days leading up to this action, you saw some institutions balking at his power and rejecting some of his actions.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这项行动开始前的几天里，你看到一些体制开始对他的权力进行阻挠，并拒绝了他的一些行动。

sentences.en: So the Supreme Court did not side with the president when it came to his executive order on mail ballots.
sentences.zh: 比如最高法院在关于邮寄选票的行政命令上并没有站在总统一边。

sentences.en: Huge loss.
sentences.zh: 巨大的损失。

sentences.en: That was a huge loss.
sentences.zh: 那是一个巨大的损失。

sentences.en: It was something he very much focused on and something that caused widespread concern about limiting mail ballots close to the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 这是他非常关注的事情，也引发了人们对在中期选举临近之际限制邮寄选票的广泛担忧。

sentences.en: How often have we talked about him and his attempts to assert power over the Fed, right?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论过多少次他试图对美联储施加权力的企图？

sentences.en: Well, the Fed decision last week, even with his handpicked successor to Jerome Powell, did not go his way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，上周美联储的决定，即便有他亲手挑选的杰罗姆·鲍威尔的继任者在内，也没有顺从他的心意。

sentences.en: The news last week, of course, being that he was going to raise interest rates, which is not what the president has been pushing for.
sentences.zh: 当然，上周的消息是他要提高利率，这并不是总统一直以来在力推的。

sentences.en: No, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不是。

sentences.en: He's railed against decisions just like that up until last week.
sentences.zh: 直到上周，他还在一直痛斥这样的决定。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that was another loss.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是一次失败。

sentences.en: You have the ongoing war in Iran as well that he said would end in a matter of four to five weeks.
sentences.zh: 还有仍在进行的伊朗战争，他曾说四到五周内就会结束。

sentences.en: Well, that hasn't happened either.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那也没有发生。

sentences.en: And energy prices continue to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 而且能源价格依然是个问题。

sentences.en: Polls show that the president's approval rating is very low.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，总统的支持率非常低。

sentences.en: His party is not in a good place as you approach the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 随着中期选举的临近，他的政党处境并不妙。

sentences.en: There were a number of moments last week where we saw government institutions rejecting President Trump's attempt to bend them to his will and assert power over them.
sentences.zh: 上周发生了好几次政府机构拒绝特朗普总统迫使它们屈服于其意志、对它们施加权力的企图。

sentences.en: And that is not something we saw often in year one of Trump's return to the White House.
sentences.zh: 这在我们看到特朗普重返白宫的第一年里是不常发生的。

sentences.en: And really what we saw last week, after various institutions basically rejected his attempt to assert power over them, he turned to a familiar target,
sentences.zh: 而事实上我们上周看到的是，在各个机构基本上拒绝了他试图对它们施加权力的企图后，他转向了一个熟悉的目标，

sentences.en: one that he could still assert some power over.
sentences.zh: 一个他仍然可以对其施加一定权力的目标。

sentences.en: And that is the media.
sentences.zh: 那就是媒体。

sentences.en: And that's the media.
sentences.zh: 也就是媒体。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the president is clearly frustrated.
sentences.zh: 所以总统显然感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: This is the context in which all of this stuff is happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一切发生时的背景。

sentences.en: Zolan, you were actually at the White House reporting last week.
sentences.zh: 佐兰，上周你实际上就在白宫进行报道。

sentences.en: How did you learn about his decision to take on the press?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得知他要拿媒体开刀的决定的？

sentences.en: Like, what did that look like on the ground?
sentences.zh: 当时在现场情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: So I, at the time, was in the Washington Bureau when we saw this true social poSt.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在华盛顿分社，我们看到了这篇真实社交的帖子。

sentences.en: And the post, just to point out, says that news outlets should not be able to report, quote, fiction and lies.
sentences.zh: 顺便指出，这篇帖子说新闻机构不应该能够报道所谓的“虚构和谎言”。

sentences.en: So that's right there is some window into what the president is thinking when he announces this ban.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是总统在宣布这项禁令时内心想法的一个窗口。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I have to be honest, you know, because the president has often railed against the media, I think there was inherent skepticism at firSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，你知道的，因为总统经常抨击媒体，我认为一开始大家内心都带着怀疑态度。

sentences.en: What does this actually mean?
sentences.zh: 这到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I go to the White House to figure out what it does mean.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了白宫去弄清楚它到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: And once I get there, I wondered, OK, are we going to be seeing our colleagues who are there doing their jobs getting escorted out?
sentences.zh: 一到那里，我就在想，好吧，我们会看到那些在那里工作的同事被护送出去吗？

sentences.en: Will they still be able to cover the president this time?
sentences.zh: 他们这次还能不能报道总统？

sentences.en: Initially, when I got there, everything seemed, frankly, normal.
sentences.zh: 起初我到那里的时候，坦率地说，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you do wonder, is this just the president riffing?
sentences.zh: 你确实会想，这只是总统随口说说吗？

sentences.en: I want to just pause here for a second, because when we were discussing how to cover this latest press ban here at The Daily, we were talking about how familiar this story sounds,
sentences.zh: 我想在这里暂停一下，因为当我们在这里讨论《每日新闻》该如何报道这一最新的媒体禁令时，我们谈到了这个故事听起来是多么熟悉，

sentences.en: because people might be aware that the administration, the Trump administration, has banned reporters from the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 因为人们可能知道，特朗普政府曾禁止记者进入五角大楼。

sentences.en: That was a big story.
sentences.zh: 那曾是个大新闻。

sentences.en: I just want to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我只想把事情弄清楚。

sentences.en: Has an administration ever banned reporters from the White House?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪届政府曾经禁止记者进入白宫？

sentences.en: Well, this president did in his first term strip the press badge of Jim Acosta, the CNN reporter.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这位总统在他的第一任期内确实剥夺了CNN记者吉姆·阿科斯塔的记者证。

sentences.en: Jim Acosta, I am in front of the White House.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·阿科斯塔，我现在在白宫前。

sentences.en: Secret Service officer is asking for my hard pass.
sentences.zh: 特勤局官员正在索要我的长期通行证。

sentences.en: And there was a court battle that ensued, and CNN won decisively.
sentences.zh: 随后引发了一场法庭诉讼，CNN取得了压倒性胜利。

sentences.en: The judge decided that Acosta should get his pass back because the White House denied him due process.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定阿科斯塔应该拿回他的通行证，因为白宫剥夺他的正当程序。

sentences.en: They didn't give him any notice that his pass is going to be revoked or any chance to rebut the White House's reasoning.
sentences.zh: 他们没有给他任何关于其通行证将被吊销的通知，也没有给他任何反驳白宫理由的机会。

sentences.en: And that's actually part of the legal precedent that we expect to come into play here when they challenge this newest ban.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我们预计在他们对这一最新禁令提出法律挑战时将发挥作用的法律先例的一部分。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: President Trump did take steps to restrict access in term one.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在第一任期内确实采取了限制采访权限的措施。

sentences.en: I would say in term two, we have seen him escalate the effort to mobilize the government to crack down on the free press.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，在第二任期中，我们看到他升级了动员政府打击自由媒体的行动。

sentences.en: We know that our own colleagues have been restricted in their access to the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们自己的同事进入五角大楼的权限受到了限制。

sentences.en: We also know that after President Trump came back to the White House, he restricted the Associated Press from certain parts of the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，在特朗普重返白宫后，他限制了美联社进入白宫的某些区域。

sentences.en: They're print reporters as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也是平面记者。

sentences.en: We also know that in this term, Trump has attempted to micromanage which outlets are covering him on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道，在这个任期内，特朗普一直试图微操哪些机构可以日常报道他。

sentences.en: He's changed the rules of which outlets can go into certain spaces in the White House.
sentences.zh: 他改变了哪些机构可以进入白宫某些空间的规则。

sentences.en: It used to be that the White House Correspondents Association would select which news organizations were in this small pool of reporters who get to be in close proximity to the president during the day.
sentences.zh: 过去一直是白宫记者协会来挑选哪些新闻机构可以进入这个小型记者池，从而在白天能够近距离接触总统。

sentences.en: This term, the Trump administration decreed that they get to cherry pick which outlets sit in that pool.
sentences.zh: 在这个任期里，特朗普政府下令由他们来精挑细选哪些机构可以进入这个记者池。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Rachel, I think the instinct, like, initially of, is this new?
sentences.zh: 所以，蕾切尔，我认为那种最初觉得“这算新鲜事吗”的本能反应，

sentences.en: Like, it's totally fair because so many people have grown used to a president that often almost daily rails against the media.
sentences.zh: 其实完全可以理解，因为有太多人已经习惯了一个几乎每天都在抨击媒体的总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。
